review_items_resolved_at.name: review_items_resolved_at
review_items_resolved_at.value: "import_review_items"."resolution" IS NULL OR "import_review_items"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL

imports_chosen_scan_date.name: imports_chosen_scan_date
imports_chosen_scan_date.value: (coalesce("imports"."date_choice", '') = 'only_scan_date') = ("imports"."chosen_scan_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("imports"."chosen_scan_date" IS NULL OR "imports"."chosen_scan_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]')

imports_counts_non_negative.name: imports_counts_non_negative
imports_counts_non_negative.value: "imports"."size_bytes" >= 0 AND "imports"."rows_total" >= 0 AND "imports"."rows_shopee" >= 0 AND "imports"."rows_excluded" >= 0 AND "imports"."excluded_codes" >= 0 AND "imports"."rows_collapsed" >= 0 AND "imports"."parcels_unique" >= 0 AND "imports"."db_duplicates" >= 0 AND "imports"."left_out" >= 0 AND "imports"."blocked" >= 0 AND "imports"."ready" >= 0 AND "imports"."parcels_added" >= 0

imports_status_rules.name: imports_status_rules
imports_status_rules.value:
CASE "imports"."status"
        WHEN 'imported' THEN "imports"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "imports"."arrival_batch_date" IS NOT NULL AND "imports"."date_choice" IS NOT NULL AND "imports"."parcels_added" = "imports"."ready" AND "imports"."blocked" = 0
        WHEN 'failed' THEN "imports"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "imports"."parcels_added" = 0 AND "imports"."error_code" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "imports"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "imports"."parcels_added" = 0
      END

scan_events_parsed_matches_raw.name: scan_events_parsed_matches_raw
scan_events_parsed_matches_raw.value:
"parcel_scan_events"."scan_time_utc" IS NULL OR (
        "parcel_scan_events"."scan_time_raw" IS NOT NULL
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', "parcel_scan_events"."scan_time_raw") IS "parcel_scan_events"."scan_time_raw"
        AND "parcel_scan_events"."scan_time_utc" IS strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "parcel_scan_events"."scan_time_raw", '-7 hours')
        AND "parcel_scan_events"."scan_date" IS substr("parcel_scan_events"."scan_time_raw", 1, 10)
      )
